hints.title: Concatenation Commutativity Test
hints.text: Two strings share a repeating divisor string if and only if concatenating them in either order produces identical results: str1 + str2 must equal str2 + str1.

hints.title: Euclidean Length Divisor
hints.text: When commutative concatenation holds, the length of the greatest common divisor string is exactly the greatest common divisor of the two string lengths.

hints.title: Prefix Slice Extraction
hints.text: Compute g = gcd(len(str1), len(str2)). Return the prefix of str1 from index 0 to g. If the concatenation check failed, return the empty string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all potential substring lengths with string division checks is slower than mathematical gcd.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Concatenation comparison and gcd computation executes in linear time with respect to total length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that str1 + str2 == str2 + str1 guarantees a periodic root and take the gcd of lengths.
complexity.notes: Standard Euclidean algorithm runs in logarithmic time.
